newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes strong on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes strong on bargain hunting.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed firmer on Tuesday as bargain hunters came into the market to take advantage of recent losses, brokers said.
The front month March contract settled $3.50 a tonne up at $163.75, having touched a session high of $164.25.
"It was very well supported today, the arb against the States got crushed," said one broker.
Brokers said that fund buyers joined local traders in the market.
IPE April Brent edged back towards session highs to trade 30 cents up at $19.22 by 1754 GMT.
"The crude arb is coming in as well," said one dealer.

April NYMEX crude was trading nine cents higher at $20.34 a barrel. Brokers said that trading on both sides of the Atlantic was inhibited by looming API stocks data, to be released after the close on trade on Tuesday.
"People are reluctant to stick their necks out, especially (on NYMEX)," said one.
Traders were expecting a build in U.S. crude stocks last week of between 1.5 and two million barrels.
